observations.seen: Frame 1 turf is lit fairly flat, with a cold blue-white sheen patch on the left. Frame 3 is an all-orange monochrome wash that flattens the players into the floor. Frame 4 has a blown hotspot at lower right that reads as a lens flare, not as a flood key.
Players sit on soft dark blob discs under their feet. Frame 3 adds long directional shadows, but frames 1 and 4 show little or no cast shadow, so grounding is inconsistent across arenas.
No convincing environment reflections. The frame 1 turf shows a mottled specular noise pattern that looks like wet plastic rather than grass sheen. The goal and kit have no reflective response.

Crowds are repeated capsule billboards in uniform rows. The stands are dark slabs with a plain green/teal hoarding strip. The goal in frame 2 has a decent net and a floodlight truss, but the arena reads as sparse.
Frame 4 has faint particle specks over the crowd and a bloom hotspot. There is essentially no indoor haze or volumetric light from the floods, so the stands do not separate in depth.
The frame 1 turf texture swims with blue-white streaky noise. Frames 3 and 4 have flat untextured court floors. Kits are flat vertex color with no cloth response.
Low-poly stylized players with simple heads and kits, readable but stiff. The ball is a small simple sphere. The goal frame in frame 2 is acceptable, with net geometry visible.

The kickoff framing centers the ball and center circle with players spread symmetrically, which reads clearly. The replay shot in frame 2 is dominated by an empty pitch, with the ball a tiny white dot.
The broadcast angle is elevated and steady, but players occupy only a small fraction of the frame. The frame 2 replay angle shows motion blur on the grass, but the ball is lost in it.
Heavy radial motion blur in frame 2. The bloom flare in frame 4 lacks a source. The frame 3 color grade is a single-hue sepia filter. There is no coherent grading across arenas.
Kickoff poses are identical static idle stances. All players face the camera rigidly, and the frames show no gait or kick pose.

A clean scoreboard with team chips, clock, and state label, plus a possession bar, a lime kickoff prompt, a replay tag, and a controls strip. It is legible and consistent, though small, and the top nav bar is a bit cluttered.
